decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The display of the advertisement hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 6 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity

Condition : 7 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (G_70638 Rev E Section 1.1, G_70638 Rev E Section 1.2, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.1, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.2, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.3, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.4, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.5, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.6, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.7, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.8, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.9, G_70638 Rev E Section 2.10, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.1, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.2, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.3, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.4,  G_70638 Rev E Section 3.5, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.6, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.7, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.8, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.9, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.10, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.11, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.12, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.13, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.14, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.15, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.16, G_70638 Rev E Section 3.17, G_70638 Rev E Section 4.1, G_70638 Rev E Section 4.2, G_70638 Rev E Section 4.3. Condition : 8 - The luminance levels of the signage hereby approved shall not exceed 300 cd/m2.
